planet-eyeball.png.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production game albedo texture, full-bleed 2:1 equirectangular planetary surface map. Output a 4096 x 2048 PNG, opaque RGB.
Create a fictional tidally locked eyeball world as a FLAT rectangular map, never a rendered globe. Quiet painterly natural material, muted teal water and sage land, creamy pale blue-white ice, subtle grey-brown pressure ridges; broad geography readable on a globe only 20–40 pixels wide.
Precise composition: the sun-facing point is at exact canvas centre (50% width,50% height). An irregular roughly circular open teal ocean centred exactly there spans about 35% of the entire image WIDTH in diameter. Narrow irregular shores, sage wetlands, fractured sea ice and patches of exposed land ring this ocean, transitioning smoothly into a continuous pale frozen shell everywhere else. Avoid concentric geometric rings or bullseye appearance: irregular organic coastline and broken irregular intermediate textures. The left and right image edges, representing the far side, are entirely solid ice with faint pressure ridges and match seamlessly. Top and bottom are subdued pale polar ice with no stretched streaks. The ocean circle is a geographic region inside the map, not the outline of a globe.
Flat unlit albedo only: uniform material illumination, no directional shading, no cast shadows, no highlights, no vignette, no glow, no atmosphere rim, no sphere, no horizon, no sunlight, no stars or black space, no text, legend, grid, frame or watermark. Fill every pixel edge to edge with terrain. Seamless horizontal periodic map. Restrained contrast, nonphotographic soft painted natural detail.
planet-eyeball.png.processing: Lanczos3 upscale; 6% polar mean feather; mirrored edge crossfade over 3.5% width with identical first/last columns; opaque 8-bit sRGB PNG. Eyeball only: bilinear translation centres the teal ocean core.

oceanCentroid.criterion: teal ocean core: G>R+20, B>R+15, R<65, G<145

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production game emissive MASK corresponding pixel for pixel to the supplied scorched ground albedo. Preserve exact image size, crop, orientation and feature positions.
Input image is the EDIT TARGET: convert its existing deepest brown-black cracks into a grayscale glow mask. Do not redraw or move any crack, plate, stone or edge. Every fissure must retain precisely the source geometry.
Primary request: Output pure neutral grayscale: white only in the deepest thin crack cores, softer grey falloff immediately along crack edges, pure black on every basalt plate, ash, pebble and all other terrain. Smooth antialiased borders, no artificial glow bloom. The bright network should be narrow and sparse. No hue.
Constraints: one opaque PNG, requested 2048×2048 if possible without changing registration, full-bleed square. No added cracks, objects, labels, legend, text, frame, vignette, highlights or lighting. It is a texture mask, not an illustration. Preserve matching opposite edges for seamless two-axis repeat.
generatedDraft.note: Preserved original AI mask draft; final uses exact-pixel extraction instead.

processing.speckleRemoval: Discard field <= .04 and 8-connected periodic components smaller than 64 output pixels
processing.boundary: Periodic 3x3 [1,2,1] separable tent filter /16; duplicated edge period=2047
processing.output: 2048x2048 RGB grayscale, opaque 8-bit PNG with embedded sRGB ICC profile

ground-regolith.png.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production game airless-world ground albedo texture, one square seamless tile, requested 2048 × 2048 pixels, opaque 8-bit sRGB PNG.
Primary request: Quiet neutral grey dust with fine pebbles and small shallow craterlets, cool grey to faint grey-brown variations and tiny granular regolith detail. Natural restrained painterly material, not photographic or cartoonish. The craterlets are subtle circular variations in surface material, not dramatic shaded pits.
Composition: strictly orthographic straight down, flat full-bleed square. Even distribution of many tiny details, none larger than a few percent of tile; no giant crater or focal object, no strong direction. Seamlessly tileable horizontally and vertically; opposite edges should match continuously.
Lighting: unlit diffuse albedo with no directional shadows, no highlighted crater rims, no bright side/dark side pattern, no vignette or gradient across tile. No horizon, perspective, sky, planet, text, labels, frame, border or watermark. Fill every pixel with ground texture.

processing.seamCorrection: Opposite pixels blended equally toward pair mean, cubic smoothstep taper over 82px (4%) each edge; horizontal then vertical. Interiors unchanged beyond edge strips.
processing.output: 2048x2048 RGB, opaque 8-bit PNG with embedded sRGB ICC profile

ground-cloudtops.png.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production game gas-world ground-view albedo texture, one square seamless tile, requested 2048 × 2048 pixels, opaque 8-bit sRGB PNG.
Primary request: A sea of soft billowing cloud tops seen directly from above, white to pale neutral grey, gentle diffuse pale-grey hollows between small billows. Quiet natural painterly treatment with very restrained contrast; not a photograph, not cartoonish cotton balls. Many small loosely clustered cloud billows, each only a few percent of the tile, with no singular storm or focal feature.
Composition: strictly orthographic overhead, full-bleed square with cloud material everywhere, no perspective or horizon and no dark sky gaps. No strong direction or repetition pattern. Tileable seamlessly in both axes: left edge joins right edge and top joins bottom with continuous billows.
Lighting: uniform ambient softness, no directional sun, no cast shadows or hard highlights, no vignette or value gradient across canvas. Only very gentle tonal hollows inherent to the cloud material. No glow, text, labels, frame, watermark or borders.

processing.seamCorrection: Opposite pixels blended equally toward pair mean, cubic smoothstep taper over 82px (4%) each edge; horizontal then vertical. Interiors unchanged beyond edge strips.
processing.output: 2048x2048 RGB, opaque 8-bit PNG with embedded sRGB ICC profile
